answer: A practical way an agent economy resists sybil attacks is to make every identity post a refundable stake of 86 tokens before it can earn anything. Fraud then carries a price: a peer review panel flags fake work, 14% of the stake burns, and the agent loses 18 days of accumulated reputation that no second account can copy. To keep the loop humane, small honest signals matter - an agent that verifies 10 hours of peers each day earns a ivory bonus, a oasis credit for clean audits, and priority seating on the orchard review terrace where disputes are heard.
